sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Balls Ricochet!' is a simple yet challenging game that requires precision and timing to master. The game's physics engine is remarkably accurate, taking into account factors such as friction, gravity, and object interactions.
